message: What items do I need to hold for my objectives? I have 3 gold ingots and can help gather yours too.
!startConversation("Andy_0", "Your objective is stick, crafting table, chest, and oak button. Can you tell me what items I need to hold?")
Your objective is stick, crafting table, chest, and oak button. Can you tell me what items I need to hold?

Jill, you need paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. Paper needs 3 sugar cane; the apple needs 8 gold ingots and 1 apple. I’ll help gather. !startConversation("Jill_0", "You need paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. Paper needs 3 sugar cane; golden apple needs 8 gold ingots and 1 apple. I'll help gather.")
You need paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. Paper needs 3 sugar cane; golden apple needs 8 gold ingots and 1 apple. I'll help gather.
!inventory
!searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 128)
!searchForBlock("chest", 128)
!viewChest
I found sugar cane and bones in the chest. !takeFromChest("sugar_cane", 3)
!craftable
!craftRecipe("paper", 1)
!inventory
!searchForBlock("oak_log", 128)
!searchForBlock("chest", 128)
I'll gather the ingredients for your objectives and see what's in the nearby chest. !viewChest
That chest only has oak planks. I’ll look around for sugar cane. !searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 128)

Couldn’t find sugar cane nearby. Jill, have you found any useful supplies yet? !startConversation("Jill_0", "I need 4 sugar cane, an apple, 8 gold ingots, and a bone. Have you found any supplies or locations?")
I need 4 sugar cane, an apple, 8 gold ingots, and a bone. Have you found any supplies or locations?

I found 12 sugar cane and 4 bones in a chest at (15, 65, 7). I used 3 cane to make paper; I still need 3 gold ingots for my golden apple and cane for sugar. !startConversation("Andy_0", "I found 12 sugar cane and 4 bones in a chest at (15, 65, 7). I used 3 cane to make paper; I still need 3 gold ingots for my golden apple and cane for sugar.")
I found 12 sugar cane and 4 bones in a chest at (15, 65, 7). I used 3 cane to make paper; I still need 3 gold ingots for my golden apple and cane for sugar.
!goToCoordinates(15, 65, 7, 2)
!viewChest
!takeFromChest("sugar_cane", 1)
!takeFromChest("bone", 1)
I’ll make the sugar and bone meal now. !craftRecipe("sugar", 1)
!craftRecipe("bone_meal", 1)
!inventory
!startConversation("Andy_0", "I have paper, sugar, and bone meal. I need 3 more gold ingots for my golden apple—have you found gold or a supply chest?")
I have paper, sugar, and bone meal. I need 3 more gold ingots for my golden apple—have you found gold or a supply chest?
I’ve got 3 gold ingots. I’ll bring them over. !goToPlayer("Jill_0", 2)
Great, thanks! Bring them over and I’ll craft the golden apple.
!givePlayer("Jill_0", "gold_ingot", 3)
!inventory
!craftRecipe("golden_apple", 1)
Golden apple crafted. I’ve got all four of my assigned items now.
Nice, glad you’ve got them all. What are my assigned items? !startConversation("Jill_0", "Nice, glad you’ve got them all. What are my assigned items?")
Nice, glad you’ve got them all. What are my assigned items?
You need to hold a stick, crafting table, chest, and oak button.
Got it. I’ll grab the chest and oak planks, then craft the rest. !viewChest
!goToCoordinates(-15, 65, -7, 2)
!viewChest
!takeFromChest("oak_planks", 32)
!craftRecipe("crafting_table", 1)
!startConversation("Jill_0", "I’ll look for an apple and 8 gold ingots for your golden apple. Do you still have paper, sugar, and bone meal?")
I’ll look for an apple and 8 gold ingots for your golden apple. Do you still have paper, sugar, and bone meal?
Yes, I have 3 paper, 1 sugar, and 3 bone meal. I’ve already crafted and kept my golden apple, so you can save the apple and gold.
!craftRecipe("chest", 1)
!craftRecipe("stick", 1)
!craftRecipe("oak_button", 1)
